name: dsh-plugin-cicd
description: 发布台（Release Console）for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a full main-panel page that show what each repository has built, what it has released, whether the local checkout is ahead of the release, whether the copy installed in this profile is the published artifact, and which version npm holds. 发布 is one press that does the whole release (发布同台): push the code, bump the version when the workflow would refuse it, dispatch release.yml asking for a draft, wait for that run, push npm, then make the draft public, then announce on Bilibili. The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. The separate buttons remain for a repository whose release must stay a draft. It also carries the third channel: when a release goes public, one short update note is posted under the video that introduces the plugin, with the credential obtained from a Bilibili sign-in inside the panel. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and the Host's own package manager, so the plugin stores no GitHub or npm credential of its own; the one credential it does own is the Bilibili session it created, kept in its own directory and never echoed back.

meta.title: DSH 插件发布台
meta.description: 面向 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布（CI/CD）：侧边栏图标 + 独立主面板，显示每个仓库的最近一次运行、已发布的 Release、本地是否领先于发布、本 profile 装的到底是哪一份（link: 本地检出 / Release 的 tgz），以及 npm 上是哪一版。浏览器登录、勾选仓库即可，复用本机已登录的 gh 与 Host 自己的包管理器，不另存 GitHub / npm 凭据。【发布】是一键发布（发布同台）：提交并推送代码 → 升版本（必要时）→ 触发 release.yml 取草稿 → 等 CI 成功 → 推 npm → 公开 Release → B 站播报，顺序不可换——npm 推送不可逆而草稿不是，所以 npm 失败时 Release 留在草稿、对外全有或全无，补上原因（如 2FA 一次性密码）即可继续，也可以选择跳过 npm 只公开 Release。装 Release 后面板接着问要不要重启（转发给 dsh-plugin-restart）；未登录 npm 时可在面板里粘贴 token 写入 npm 自己的 .npmrc。第三条渠道是 B 站更新播报：Release 公开后，在绑定的视频评论区自动补一条简短的更新说明——只认已公开的 Release（草稿不算），按 (仓库, tag) 幂等，绑定视频时写入基线所以不追发历史版本；凭据走面板内的 B 站登录（passport 网页二维码）或粘贴一次，落在插件自己的目录里、不回显，并且会真的去问一次账号接口——因为 biliup 默认写下的 cookies.json 是 BiliTV 登录，发评论走的却是 Web 接口。门禁与产包形状按 DSH bundle 设计（契约检查 + 整树 zip + 可安装 tgz + npm），任何带 ci.yml / release.yml 的仓库都能接。
